onboarding.welcomeBody: A guided way to read, save, and reflect on Thirukkural. Set a few preferences now, then start exploring.
onboarding.setupBody: Set your language, name, and viewing preferences before you begin.
onboarding.introBody: Swipe through a few pages to get oriented, then personalize the app in a few taps.
onboarding.languageSetupBody: Choose the language you want to see first.
onboarding.introPoint3: Learn where the main features live
onboarding.overviewBody: Explore verses, save bookmarks, ask Guru for guidance, and adjust settings anytime.
onboarding.exploreCardBody: Browse the full verse catalog and filters.
onboarding.searchTipBody: Search by verse text, meaning, translation, or Kural number.
onboarding.filtersTipBody: Use Filters to narrow the catalog by section, subsection, or chapter.
onboarding.homeCardBody: Your daily Kural and personal reading start here.
onboarding.bookmarksCardBody: Keep verses you want to return to.
onboarding.guruCardBody: Ask questions and get guided commentary.
onboarding.settingsCardBody: Change language, theme, fonts, and preferences.
onboarding.bookmarkTipBody: This tutorial saves today's Kural as an example. Tap this icon on any Kural to save or remove it.
onboarding.bookmarkRemoveTipBody: Use the bookmark icon on any saved Kural to remove only that item.
onboarding.bookmarkClearTipBody: Use this action when you want to remove every saved Kural at once. You will be asked to confirm.
onboarding.settingsNameTipBody: Add the English name used in your greeting.

onboarding.settingsAuthorTipBody: Choose which author's commentary appears first.
onboarding.settingsNotesTipBody: Turn your private notes on or off.
onboarding.settingsColorTipBody: Open the palette dropdown and choose colors by preview.
onboarding.settingsAppearanceTipBody: Choose light, dark, or your device setting.
onboarding.settingsSizeTipBody: Change text size throughout the app. Content expands so text is not clipped.
onboarding.settingsListTipBody: Choose responsive, full, or compact cards and the details shown in compact mode.
onboarding.settingsTamilFontTipBody: Choose the font used for all Tamil text.
onboarding.settingsEnglishFontTipBody: Choose the font used for all English text.
onboarding.settingsLanguageTipBody: Choose Tamil, English, or both independently for each part of the app.
onboarding.settingsRestartTipBody: Restart these contextual tips at any time from the Reset section.
onboarding.settingsResetTipBody: Restore every default and clear all bookmarks and app data. A confirmation protects against accidental reset.
onboarding.preferencesBody: Add a name and pick a look you prefer. You can change everything later in Settings.
